description: Seeded redundancy mismatch (REQ-11): a consumer receives data from two branches with different codomain shapes (Record[Scalar,Scalar] vs Parameterized{Option,[Scalar]}) and no adapter reconciles them. The two REQ-7 composition-breaks that used to fire here were unit-callee-codomain return-boundary FPs (use_data's hand-modeled codomain is Scalar(Unit)) — suppressed since vampiro-s3e, which gates compiler-subsumed unit-vs-value return comparisons on same-language Rust boundaries. The seeded REQ-11 redundancy defect remains the TP.
